title: गौँथलीको चिरिबिरी (१)
description: From the collection लालित्य भाग १. Lekhnath Paudyal's poem "गौँथलीको चिरिबिरी (१)" is a sixteen-stanza dialogue in which a swallow (gaunthali) that has nested on a beam in the poet's room pleads with him, the house's owner, to let her shelter there through the night after a devastating earthquake has destroyed the birds' own dwelling.

rights.basis: Author died 1966; public domain since 2016 (Nepal's Copyright Act 2059: life + 50 years).
